classification.difficultyReason: Use the parallel-line markings to relate the exterior angle to the lower interior angle, then identify its adjacent side and hypotenuse for inverse cosine.

content.prompt: Calculate the value of $\theta$ in these diagrams. Answer to 1 d.p.

spec.description: Oblique right triangle with hypotenuse 9, lower-left to right side 8, and a right-angle marker at the right vertex. An exterior ray from the top runs down-left parallel to the side labelled 8. Matching arrows and theta between that ray and the hypotenuse are retained. Ordinary source blue strokes are rendered black.
spec.mathematics: The angle at the lower-left vertex equals theta by alternate angles; its cosine is 8/9.

answer.worked:
The lower-left interior angle equals $\theta$ because alternate angles between parallel lines are equal.
$$\begin{align*}\cos\theta&=\frac{8}{9}\\\theta&=\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{8}{9}\right)\\\theta&\approx27.3^{\circ}\end{align*}$$
